messages.subject: standard error computation error
parts:
Dear all,

I have written a model which keeps getting the same error:

model = '

#latente variabelen
moral_disengagement =~ 1*MD_trend + MD_trend2 + MD_fictie + MD_fictie2 + MD_fictie3 + MD_mens + MD_mens2 + MD_victim + MD_victim2 + MD_victim3 + MD_just + MD_just2 + MD_mind + MD_MD + MD_MD2
play_experience =~ 1*escape_play + escape_play2 + emo_onbehagen + emo_onbehagen2 + emo_onbehagen3 + eigenrichting3
enjoyment =~ 1*leuk + 1*rapporcijfer_afl
sympathy =~ 1*emp_dex + ident_dex + symp_dex


#regressies
enjoyment ~ sympathy + moral_disengagement + play_experience
sympathy ~ moral_disengagement
moral_disengagement ~  play_experience
play_experience ~ moral_disengagement

#residual variances

MD_trend ~~ MD_trend
MD_trend2 ~~ MD_trend2
MD_fictie ~~ MD_fictie
MD_fictie2 ~~ MD_fictie2
MD_fictie3 ~~ MD_fictie3
MD_mens ~~ MD_mens
MD_mens2 ~~ MD_mens2
MD_victim ~~ MD_victim
MD_victim2 ~~ MD_victim2
MD_victim3 ~~ MD_victim3 
MD_just ~~ MD_just
MD_just2 ~~ MD_just2
MD_mind ~~ MD_mind
MD_MD ~~ MD_MD
MD_MD2 ~~ MD_MD2
escape_play ~~ escape_play
escape_play2 ~~ escape_play2
emo_onbehagen ~~ emo_onbehagen
emo_onbehagen2 ~~ emo_onbehagen2
emo_onbehagen3 ~~ emo_onbehagen3
eigenrichting3 ~~ eigenrichting3
rapporcijfer_afl ~~ rapporcijfer_afl
emp_dex ~~ emp_dex
ident_dex ~~ ident_dex
symp_dex ~~ symp_dex

#factor variances
enjoyment ~~ enjoyment
sympathy ~~ sympathy
moral_disengagement ~~ moral_disengagement
play_experience ~~ play_experience'


fit = lavaan(model, data = data, auto.fix.first = FALSE, model.type = "sem")

summary (fit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

I have worked with many sem models, but this is the first time that I really do not see where the mistake is. 
I guess the model is underidentified, but I honestly don't see it..

I hope someone can help me!

Lisa

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: standard error computation error
parts:
Hi Lisa,

I might recommend trying to fit the model with the sem command. The sem command includes some defaults for model specification and it might clean up what's missing (of course I'd check the results to see if the right parameters are being estimated).

For your script the command would be:

fit = sem(model, data = data)

Alex
